answer: Propose one weekly vote per ID archiving a disjoint 10 GiB shard of encrypted quartz spectra, nectar assays and oasis water logs. Validators issue surprise chunk audits, checking Merkle proofs against archive roots; late or invalid replies void that week's vote. Assume incompressible shards and deadlines too short for reconstruction; sampling can miss deletions and colluding validators can fake passes. Disks are reusable capital; power or rent recurs. Shared disks and parallel audits cannot double-count bytes: ten IDs must retain 100 GiB for the week.
